name: Optomechanics
description: Study of coupled optical and mechanical systems, including light-induced motion, mechanical measurement, dynamical control, and quantum behavior of interacting optical-mechanical degrees of freedom.

name: Particle Phenomenology
description: Study of particle interactions through their observable consequences, including theoretical predictions, parameter constraints, and relationships between particle models and experimental evidence.

name: Pattern Formation
description: Study of the emergence and dynamics of organized spatial structures, including instabilities, symmetry breaking, pattern selection, and interactions between evolving patterns.

name: Philosophy of Physics
description: Study of conceptual and philosophical questions arising from physical theories, including explanation, ontology, interpretation, and the foundations of physical knowledge.

name: Photonics
description: Study of generating, guiding, and controlling light in devices and integrated systems, including photonic architectures, materials, and functional performance.

name: Physics Education Research
description: Study of how physics is learned and taught, including conceptual understanding, instruction, assessment, and empirical evidence about educational practices.

name: Planetary Science
description: Study of planetary bodies and systems, including formation, interiors, surfaces, atmospheres, and the physical processes shaping their evolution.

name: Plasma Physics
description: Study of ionized matter and its collective behavior, including electromagnetic interactions, instabilities, transport, and the dynamics of laboratory or natural plasmas.

name: Polymer Physics
description: Study of the physical behavior of macromolecules, including conformations, interactions, dynamics, phase behavior, and the properties of polymer materials.

name: Quantum Chemistry
description: Study of chemical systems through quantum descriptions, including electronic structure, molecular states, chemical energetics, and methods for predicting molecular properties.

name: Quantum Chromodynamics
description: Study of the strong interaction through quarks and gluons, including confinement, gauge dynamics, hadronic structure, and strongly interacting phases of matter.

name: Quantum Field Theory
description: Study of physical systems described by quantized fields, including interactions, symmetries, renormalization, and the structural properties of field theories.

name: Quantum Foundations
description: Study of the conceptual and operational foundations of quantum theory, including interpretation, nonlocality, contextuality, and relationships between quantum principles and observations.

name: Quantum Gases
description: Study of degenerate atomic and molecular gases, including tunable interactions, collective quantum phases, dynamics, and behavior in confined or structured environments.

name: Quantum Gravity
description: Study of gravitational phenomena within quantum descriptions, including quantum spacetime, gravitational degrees of freedom, and consistency between quantum and gravitational principles.

name: Quantum Information
description: Study of information encoded in quantum systems, including entanglement, communication, resource theories, and fundamental limits on quantum information processing.

name: Quantum Magnetism
description: Study of magnetic phenomena governed by quantum interactions, including spin systems, magnetic phases, collective excitations, and quantum correlations in magnetic materials.

name: Quantum Measurement
description: Study of observation and inference in quantum systems, including measurement backaction, state estimation, measurement dynamics, and the information obtained from quantum observations.

name: Quantum Optics
description: Study of quantum phenomena involving light, including quantum optical states, correlations, measurement, and the interaction of light with quantum matter.

name: Quantum Sensing
description: Study of sensing and metrology using quantum systems, including parameter estimation, quantum-enhanced precision, sensor design, and the effects of noise.

name: Quantum Simulation
description: Study of using controllable quantum systems to represent other quantum systems, including simulator design, model realization, dynamics, and verification of simulated behavior.

name: Quantum Thermodynamics
description: Study of thermodynamic processes in quantum systems, including heat, work, thermalization, fluctuations, and the use of quantum resources in thermal operations.

name: Radiation Physics
description: Study of radiation and its interactions with matter, including propagation, absorption, scattering, energy deposition, and the physical response of irradiated systems.

name: Science Communication
description: Study of communicating scientific knowledge, including public understanding, audiences, communication practices, and relationships between science, media, and social institutions.

name: Semiconductor Physics
description: Study of semiconductor materials and their physical behavior, including electronic structure, optical response, carrier dynamics, and transport under different conditions.

name: Soft Matter Physics
description: Study of deformable materials with mesoscopic structure, including interactions, mechanical response, collective organization, and the dynamics of complex soft materials.

name: Solar Physics
description: Study of the Sun and its physical activity, including magnetic fields, atmospheric dynamics, solar variability, and the generation of solar eruptions.

name: Space Physics
description: Study of physical processes in space environments, including space plasmas, magnetospheres, ionospheres, and interactions between the Sun and planetary systems.

name: Star Formation
description: Study of the formation of stars from interstellar matter, including gravitational collapse, accretion, fragmentation, feedback, and the emergence of stellar populations.

name: Stellar Astrophysics
description: Study of the physical properties of stars, including internal structure, atmospheres, radiation, magnetic activity, and relationships among stellar populations.

name: Stellar Evolution
description: Study of changes in stars throughout their lifetimes, including nuclear burning, structural evolution, mass loss, and the formation of stellar remnants.

name: String Theory
description: Study of physical theories involving extended quantum objects, including string dynamics, dualities, compactification, and the structure of quantum spacetime.

name: Strongly Correlated Electron Systems
description: Study of electronic systems dominated by collective interaction effects, including correlated phases, emergent excitations, quantum criticality, and unconventional electronic behavior.

name: Superconductivity
description: Study of superconducting states and their physical properties, including pairing, collective order, transport, electromagnetic response, and the mechanisms supporting superconductivity.

name: Supersymmetry
description: Study of theories relating bosonic and fermionic degrees of freedom, including symmetry structure, symmetry breaking, dynamical consequences, and observable implications.

name: Surface and Interface Physics
description: Study of physical phenomena at material boundaries, including surface states, interfacial interactions, structural organization, and boundary-dependent electronic or mechanical properties.

name: Thermodynamics
description: Study of macroscopic physical constraints involving heat, work, and entropy, including equilibrium relations, thermodynamic processes, and the transformation of energy.

name: Topological Matter
description: Study of physical phases organized by topological properties, including bulk invariants, boundary phenomena, protected excitations, and transitions between topological phases.

name: Turbulence
description: Study of irregular multiscale fluid motion, including fluctuations, energy transfer, turbulent transport, and the statistical organization of complex flows.

name: Ultrafast Optics
description: Study of short optical pulses and rapid physical processes, including pulse generation, time-resolved measurement, and light-matter interactions on short timescales.

name: Adaptive Control
description: Study of feedback systems that adjust to uncertain or changing dynamics, including adaptation mechanisms, stability, learning, and closed-loop performance.

name: Array Signal Processing
description: Study of extracting information from multiple sensing elements, including spatial filtering, source localization, array design, and processing of correlated observations.

name: Biomedical Signal Processing
description: Study of information in biological and physiological signals, including measurement modeling, signal analysis, diagnostic features, and interpretation of biomedical observations.

name: Communication Signal Processing
description: Study of signal-level methods for communication systems, including synchronization, detection, equalization, channel estimation, and the recovery of transmitted information.

name: Computational Imaging
description: Study of jointly designing image acquisition and computation, including sensing systems, physical image formation, reconstruction, and the limits of recoverable information.

name: Cyber-Physical Systems
description: Study of systems coupling computation with physical processes, including system architecture, interaction, verification, and the reliability of integrated computational-physical behavior.

name: Digital Signal Processing
description: Study of processing signals represented in discrete form, including sampling, digital filters, transforms, numerical algorithms, and efficient signal-processing implementations.

name: Distributed Control
description: Study of controlling interacting dynamical systems through distributed decisions, including coordination, decentralized feedback, communication, and collective stability or performance.

name: Electronic Circuit Design
description: Study of designing electrical circuits, including circuit architectures, signal behavior, implementation constraints, and the tradeoffs determining circuit functionality and performance.

name: Event-Triggered Control
description: Study of feedback systems whose updates depend on events, including triggering rules, communication efficiency, stability, and performance under limited resources.

name: Hybrid Systems
description: Study of systems combining continuous dynamics with discrete transitions, including modeling, stability, verification, and the design of hybrid control systems.

name: Image Processing
description: Study of computational transformations of images, including reconstruction, enhancement, restoration, compression, and representations preserving useful visual or measurement information.

name: Internet of Things
description: Study of connected physical devices and their services, including sensing, interoperability, device coordination, resource constraints, and reliable operation of connected environments.

name: Model Predictive Control
description: Study of feedback based on repeated finite-horizon optimization, including constraints, stability, uncertainty, computational methods, and performance of predictive control schemes.

name: Networked Control Systems
description: Study of feedback systems operating through communication networks, including delays, packet losses, coordination, resource limitations, and closed-loop performance guarantees.

name: Nonlinear Control
description: Study of feedback and observation for nonlinear dynamical systems, including stabilization, controllability, estimation, and the effects of nonlinear system structure.

name: Optimal Control
description: Study of controlling dynamical systems to optimize performance criteria, including feedback design, trajectory planning, constraints, and the structure of optimal decisions.

name: Power Electronics
description: Study of electronic systems for converting and controlling electrical power, including converter architectures, switching behavior, control, and energy-conversion performance.

name: Power Systems
description: Study of electrical energy networks, including generation, transmission, operation, stability, and the integration of diverse resources into power grids.

name: Radar Signal Processing
description: Study of extracting information from radar measurements, including target detection, parameter estimation, radar imaging, and the effects of clutter or interference.

name: Robust Control
description: Study of feedback design with guarantees under uncertainty, including modeling errors, disturbances, stability margins, and performance across uncertain system conditions.

name: Semiconductor Devices
description: Study of engineered semiconductor components, including device structures, operating mechanisms, fabrication effects, and the performance of electronic or optoelectronic devices.

name: Signal Processing
description: Study of extracting and transforming information in signals, including representation, filtering, detection, estimation, and the performance of signal-processing methods.

name: State Estimation
description: Study of inferring dynamic-system states from observations, including incomplete measurements, noise, observability, uncertainty, and the performance of state-reconstruction procedures.

name: Statistical Signal Processing
description: Study of inference from random signals, including stochastic models, detection, estimation, uncertainty, and statistical guarantees for signal-processing procedures.

name: Stochastic Control
description: Study of dynamical decisions under randomness, including stochastic feedback, partial observation, uncertainty, and the optimization of probabilistic performance criteria.

name: System Identification
description: Study of learning dynamic-system models from observations and experiments, including model structure, parameter estimation, identifiability, and predictive model performance.

name: Video Processing
description: Study of processing temporal sequences of images, including motion, reconstruction, enhancement, compression, and relationships between spatial and temporal information.

name: Wireless Communications
description: Study of information transmission through wireless channels, including channel behavior, modulation, interference, transmission strategies, and the reliability of physical communication links.

name: Biomechanics
description: Study of mechanical behavior in biological systems, including forces, deformation, motion, and relationships between mechanical properties and physiological structure or function.

name: Biomolecular Dynamics
description: Study of motion and change in biomolecules, including conformational transitions, molecular interactions, kinetics, and relationships between dynamics and biological function.

name: Cellular Biophysics
description: Study of physical processes in cells, including mechanics, transport, cellular organization, interactions, and the physical mechanisms supporting cell behavior.

name: Computational Genomics
description: Study of computational methods for genomic data and processes, including sequence analysis, genome organization, variation, and inference from genomic measurements.

name: Computational Neuroscience
description: Study of nervous systems through computational models and analysis, including neural dynamics, information processing, circuit organization, and mechanisms of cognition or behavior.

name: Epidemiological Modeling
description: Study of disease and health dynamics through quantitative models, including transmission, population structure, intervention effects, and uncertainty in epidemic or health predictions.

name: Evolutionary Dynamics
description: Study of evolutionary change in biological populations, including selection, adaptation, competition, and the dynamics of interacting organisms or inherited traits.

name: Gene Regulation
description: Study of the mechanisms controlling gene expression, including regulatory interactions, signaling, expression dynamics, and relationships between regulation and cellular behavior.

name: Microbial Ecology
description: Study of microbial populations and communities, including ecological interactions, environmental responses, community organization, and the dynamics of microbial ecosystems.

name: Molecular Evolution
description: Study of evolutionary change in biological molecules, including sequence variation, selection, molecular mechanisms, and relationships between molecular changes and evolutionary history.

name: Pharmacometrics
description: Study of quantitative models of drug disposition and effects, including exposure-response relationships, population variability, dosing, and inference supporting pharmacological decisions.

name: Phylogenetics
description: Study of evolutionary relationships among organisms or biological sequences, including tree inference, ancestral reconstruction, evolutionary models, and uncertainty in inferred histories.

name: Population Genetics
description: Study of genetic variation within and between populations, including inheritance, selection, drift, migration, and the forces shaping population genetic structure.

name: Protein Design
description: Study of designing protein sequences and structures for desired properties, including molecular function, stability, interactions, and evaluation of engineered proteins.

name: Protein Folding
description: Study of how proteins acquire functional conformations, including folding pathways, energy landscapes, kinetic mechanisms, stability, and misfolding processes.

name: Quantitative Developmental Biology
description: Study of biological development through quantitative measurements and models, including morphogenesis, cell differentiation, tissue organization, and mechanisms generating developmental patterns.

name: Quantitative Genetics
description: Study of genetic contributions to quantitative traits, including inheritance, trait variation, genetic architecture, and relationships between genotype and phenotype.

name: Statistical Genetics
description: Study of statistical inference for genetic variation and inheritance, including association, genetic architecture, population structure, and relationships between genetic measurements and traits.

name: Structural Biology
description: Study of biomolecular structures and assemblies, including structural determination, molecular organization, interactions, and relationships between structure and biological function.

name: Synthetic Biology
description: Study of designing and constructing biological systems, including engineered genetic circuits, cellular functions, design principles, and the control of biological behavior.

name: Systems Biology
description: Study of biological behavior through interacting system components, including molecular networks, feedback, multiscale organization, and relationships between interactions and biological function.

name: Systems Immunology
description: Study of immune behavior through interacting components and quantitative models, including immune networks, response dynamics, regulation, and variation in immune function.

name: Theoretical Ecology
description: Study of ecological systems through theoretical models, including population dynamics, community interactions, biodiversity, and mechanisms governing ecosystem organization or persistence.

name: Algorithmic Trading
description: Study of automated trading and execution strategies, including decision rules, market interaction, transaction costs, and the performance of trading systems.

name: Asset Pricing
description: Study of asset values and returns, including risk premia, valuation mechanisms, market equilibrium, and relationships between economic conditions and financial prices.

name: Behavioral Finance
description: Study of behavioral influences on financial decisions and markets, including beliefs, preferences, biases, and their effects on investment or price dynamics.

name: Climate Finance
description: Study of financial responses to climate-related change, including climate risks, investment, asset valuation, and the allocation of capital for mitigation or adaptation.

name: Computational Finance
description: Study of computational methods for financial models and decisions, including simulation, numerical valuation, optimization, and the accuracy or efficiency of financial computations.

name: Corporate Finance
description: Study of financial decisions within firms, including investment, financing, capital structure, governance, and relationships between firm organization and financial outcomes.

name: Credit Risk
description: Study of risks associated with borrower default and credit quality, including default dynamics, credit exposures, recovery, and credit-dependent valuation.

name: Derivative Pricing and Hedging
description: Study of valuation and risk control for contingent financial claims, including contract structure, pricing models, hedging strategies, and market imperfections.

name: Econophysics
description: Study of economic and financial systems using statistical-physics concepts, including collective dynamics, distributions, interactions, and emergent behavior in economic systems.

name: Financial Econometrics
description: Study of statistical models and inference for financial data, including returns, volatility, dependence, market dynamics, and the evaluation of financial hypotheses.

name: Financial Market Microstructure
description: Study of how trading institutions shape markets, including order flow, liquidity, price formation, transaction costs, and interactions among market participants.

name: Financial Risk Management
description: Study of measuring and managing financial losses, including risk models, aggregation, stress, and decisions controlling exposure under uncertain market or institutional conditions.

name: Insurance Mathematics
description: Study of mathematical models for insurance and actuarial decisions, including claim processes, reserves, risk aggregation, pricing, and the management of insurance uncertainty.

name: Portfolio Optimization
description: Study of investment allocation under objectives and constraints, including diversification, risk-return tradeoffs, dynamic allocation, and robustness of portfolio decisions.

name: Systemic Financial Risk
description: Study of instability across interconnected financial institutions and markets, including contagion, interdependence, amplification, and mechanisms producing system-wide financial losses.

name: Auction Theory
description: Study of economic allocation through bidding mechanisms, including information, bidding strategies, auction formats, revenue, and efficiency of auction outcomes.

name: Behavioral Economics
description: Study of economic behavior shaped by psychological mechanisms, including preferences, beliefs, judgment, and departures from conventional models of economic choice.

name: Contract Theory
description: Study of agreements under incentives and information constraints, including contract design, enforcement, ownership, and the allocation of risk or decision rights.

name: Decision Theory
description: Study of principles governing individual choice, including preferences, beliefs, uncertainty, rationality, and the evaluation of alternative actions or outcomes.

name: Development Economics
description: Study of economic development and poverty, including institutions, structural change, household decisions, and the effects of development policies or interventions.

name: Econometrics
description: Study of methods for empirical economic inference, including identification, estimation, testing, and the interpretation of economic relationships from observed data.

name: Economic Growth
description: Study of long-run changes in economic production and living standards, including technological progress, accumulation, institutions, and mechanisms generating sustained growth.

name: Economic History
description: Study of economic change in historical settings, including institutions, production, markets, living standards, and evidence about long-run economic development.

name: Education Economics
description: Study of economic decisions and outcomes involving education, including schooling, investment, institutions, skills, and the effects of education policies.

name: Energy Economics
description: Study of economic behavior in energy systems, including energy demand, supply, markets, investment, and the effects of energy-related policies.

name: Environmental Economics
description: Study of economic relationships with the environment, including externalities, natural resources, environmental valuation, and incentives created by environmental policies.

name: Experimental Economics
description: Study of economic behavior through controlled experiments, including experimental institutions, incentive responses, social interaction, and methods for interpreting experimental evidence.

name: Health Economics
description: Study of economic choices and institutions involving health, including health behavior, insurance, care provision, and the effects of health policies.

name: Industrial Organization
description: Study of firms and market competition, including market structure, strategic behavior, pricing, regulation, and the consequences of industrial organization.

name: International Macroeconomics
description: Study of macroeconomic interactions across countries, including exchange rates, capital flows, external balances, and the transmission of international economic disturbances.

name: International Trade
description: Study of exchange and production across countries, including trade patterns, firms, trade policy, specialization, and the economic consequences of international commerce.

name: Labor Economics
description: Study of labor markets and employment decisions, including wages, skills, mobility, institutions, and the economic effects of labor-market policies.

name: Macroeconomics
description: Study of aggregate economic behavior, including output, employment, inflation, fluctuations, and the interactions between economic institutions and macroeconomic policy.

name: Market Design
description: Study of constructing and improving allocation institutions, including exchanges, auctions, matching systems, and the effects of market rules on participants or outcomes.

name: Matching Markets
description: Study of allocation through matching institutions, including preferences, incentives, stability, constraints, and the design or behavior of two-sided markets.

name: Mechanism Design
description: Study of designing rules for interacting agents with private information, including incentives, implementation, efficiency, and the achievement of desired allocation outcomes.

name: Microeconomic Theory
description: Study of individual and organizational economic choices, including preferences, incentives, markets, equilibrium, and the allocation of resources among interacting agents.

name: Monetary Economics
description: Study of money and monetary institutions, including inflation, monetary policy, payment systems, and interactions between financial conditions and aggregate economic behavior.

name: Network Economics
description: Study of economic interaction through networks, including network formation, strategic behavior, diffusion, and the effects of connectivity on economic outcomes.

name: Organizational Economics
description: Study of economic organization within and between institutions, including incentives, coordination, firm boundaries, decision rights, and the consequences of organizational structures.

name: Political Economy
description: Study of interactions between economic outcomes and political processes, including institutions, power, collective decisions, and the economic effects of political incentives.

name: Public Economics
description: Study of government activity and collective resource allocation, including taxation, public expenditure, public goods, redistribution, and the effects of public policies.

name: Social Choice Theory
description: Study of collective decisions from individual preferences, including aggregation, voting, fairness, welfare, and the properties of social decision rules.

name: Urban and Regional Economics
description: Study of the spatial organization of economic activity, including cities, regions, location choices, local markets, and spatial effects of economic policies.

name: Bayesian Nonparametric Statistics
description: Study of Bayesian inference with flexible or infinite-dimensional models, including priors, posterior behavior, adaptation, and inference for complex data structures.

name: Bayesian Optimization
description: Study of sequential optimization using probabilistic models, including surrogate construction, informative evaluations, exploration, and efficient optimization under limited observations.

name: Biostatistics
description: Study of statistical methods for biological and health questions, including study design, inference, uncertainty, and interpretation of biological or medical observations.

name: Change-Point Analysis
description: Study of detecting and characterizing changes in data-generating processes, including change localization, structural transitions, and uncertainty in changing statistical regimes.

name: Compositional Data Analysis
description: Study of statistical information in relative multivariate measurements, including compositional geometry, ratios, dependence, and inference for constrained compositions.

name: Design of Experiments
description: Study of organizing experiments to obtain useful information, including allocation, randomization, design structure, efficiency, and the relationship between design and inference.

name: Directional Statistics
description: Study of statistical inference for directional observations, including angular distributions, orientation, directional dependence, and procedures respecting the geometry of directions.

name: Environmental Statistics
description: Study of statistical information about environmental systems, including environmental measurements, dependence, exposure, prediction, and uncertainty in environmental processes or impacts.

name: Extreme-Value Statistics
description: Study of statistical behavior in distributional tails, including extremes, rare events, tail dependence, and extrapolation beyond routinely observed values.

name: Functional Data Analysis
description: Study of observations represented as functions, including curves, surfaces, functional dependence, dimension reduction, and statistical inference for functional variation.

name: High-Dimensional Statistics
description: Study of statistical inference when data dimension is large relative to observations, including estimation, regularization, uncertainty, and high-dimensional performance guarantees.

name: Missing Data Analysis
description: Study of inference from incomplete observations, including missingness mechanisms, identification, estimation, and sensitivity to assumptions about unobserved data.

name: Multiple Testing
description: Study of inference involving many hypotheses, including simultaneous decisions, error rates, dependence, and the reliability of statistical discoveries.

name: Multivariate Statistics
description: Study of statistical relationships among multiple variables, including dependence, dimension reduction, joint distributions, and inference for multivariate observations.

name: Official Statistics
description: Study of producing and evaluating public population statistics, including data integration, measurement quality, disclosure, and inference supporting official statistical products.

name: Probabilistic Graphical Models
description: Study of probability distributions represented through graphical structure, including conditional dependence, latent variables, inference, and learning of structured probabilistic relationships.

name: Psychometrics
description: Study of measurement for psychological and behavioral constructs, including latent traits, assessment instruments, reliability, validity, and statistical models of responses.

name: Reliability Statistics
description: Study of statistical inference for failures and system dependability, including lifetime distributions, degradation, repair, and the reliability of interacting components.

name: Robust Statistics
description: Study of statistical procedures under imperfect model assumptions, including contamination, outliers, misspecification, and tradeoffs between robustness and inferential performance.

name: Semiparametric Statistics
description: Study of inference combining finite-dimensional targets with flexible model components, including nuisance structure, efficiency, robustness, and uncertainty for semiparametric procedures.

name: Sequential Analysis
description: Study of inference as observations accumulate, including sequential tests, stopping rules, estimation, and tradeoffs between information, sampling cost, and decision performance.

name: Spatial Statistics
description: Study of statistical information organized across space, including spatial dependence, sampling, prediction, and inference for geographically or geometrically structured observations.

name: Statistical Decision Theory
description: Study of statistical decisions under uncertainty, including loss functions, optimal procedures, risk, and the performance of inference-based actions.

name: Statistical Model Selection
description: Study of choosing and comparing statistical models, including variable selection, selection criteria, predictive performance, and inference accounting for model-selection uncertainty.

name: Statistical Network Analysis
description: Study of statistical models and inference for network observations, including graph dependence, network formation, latent structure, and uncertainty in network analysis.

name: Survey Sampling
description: Study of inference about populations from designed samples, including sampling schemes, weighting, survey errors, and the estimation of population quantities.

name: Survival Analysis
description: Study of time-to-event data, including event processes, censoring, hazards, competing events, and statistical inference for event-time distributions.

name: Time Series Analysis
description: Study of observations dependent across time, including temporal structure, forecasting, dynamic models, and statistical inference for evolving data.
